name: AI-Boost 4.0 for Red Alert
description:
# AI-Boost 4.0 for Red Alert
Local source update: 5 October 2026

AI-Boost 4.0 builds on AI-Boost 3.2b by Bast75 and xXMini FrankiXx.

Main updates:
- A combat-unit lead strictly above thirty triggers immediate full ground/naval/air assaults without ordinary reserves, random rolls or attack/economy/local power vetoes. Counts cover living armed mobile units across hostile houses; available recruitment preserves economic vehicles, native teams and rearming.
- More than twenty ready tanks prefer reachable power-plant and refinery sectors.
- Normal ground/naval attacks use ten-second default wave opportunities, two-second target/route scans and six-second target reconsideration. Exposed enemy units remain eligible while buildings exist.
- Ready aircraft independently seek power plants every eight seconds alongside ground/fleet attacks. Single loaded aircraft can harass exposed targets while anti-air, weapon and rearming checks remain.
- Armies gather before advancing through shared checkpoints, with a defensive reserve during normal waves.
- Close ground/naval encounters are checked every three simulation ticks. Groups immediately fight, each unit favors effective nearby targets, and shared damage estimates reduce overkill. The original objective is retained for resuming after combat.
- At least 20 available tanks at 50% health or better and 10,000 combined estimated power enable a 25% random all-out ground assault chance every 30 simulation seconds, with a three-minute cooldown. Reserves and ground escorts can join; active base raids defer the assault and reachable safe local targets remain required.
- Targets and routes are reassessed every two simulation seconds; attacks favor reachable weak sectors and avoid the enemy main army.
- Ordinary attacks need local advantage over nearby defenders and reachable reinforcements, without a global enemy-strength veto. Moving enemy forces can redirect the wave to another weak sector.
- Ready waves use short attack opportunities; covered minor raids leave spare forces available for offense.
- Nearby reachable units protect the base, exposed harvesters and travelling MCVs; new towers cover threatened approaches.
- Massed enemy tanks favor heavy armor production while the AI maintains harvesting and recovery.
- Harvesters favor nearby reachable rich ore, distribute across patches, and choose refineries by route and unloading queues.
- Waiting trucks keep the docking entrance clear; critically damaged loaded trucks can return early.
- From five simulation minutes, funded economies maintain at least two refineries and two War Factories; enabled one-building strategy caps gain a minimum of two.
- Construction yards and undeployed MCVs combined have a minimum goal of two. A safely served dense ore field can support the second base; route, separation, follow-up space and full funding still apply.
- Storage at 90% of native ore capacity plans at least two silos, then retains a two-silo free-capacity buffer. Silo placement protects mining traffic and production exits; funding and power checks preserve ongoing production.
- Funded MCVs expand near safe reachable ore, reserve refinery/power space and follow short route checkpoints. Newly threatened MCVs replan or retreat.
- Distant ore routes favor closer legal refineries; resource outposts provide construction proximity when needed.
- Additional funded War Factories increase tank production through native speed bonuses, respecting Aftermath and configured caps.
- Unpaid production and pending outpost funds are reserved before optional spending. Lost first factories recover, and a funded safe outpost can prioritize the missing MCV Repair Depot.
- Whole-economy ore checks recover stale shortage flags; one blocked truck no longer freezes growth.
- One optional low-priority funded kennel and a two-minute rebuilding cooldown stop immediate kennel build/sell loops.
- Aircraft coordinate common sorties and ships gather as fleets, with compatible weapon and target checks.
- AI production, strategy selection, recovery and target selection retain the earlier 4.0 fixes.
- A sprite-renderer address-calculation defect causing terrain-drawing startup crashes is repaired.

Validation: Release/Win32 build with zero warnings/errors, 535 AI checks (including 193 economic expansion and 80 harvester scenarios), 16,164 actual-assembly renderer scenarios, and all 44 exported names/ordinals passed.
The latest offensive update includes the numerical assault, frequent air harassment, economic targeting, infrastructure, encounter and economy recovery fixes and is recorded in a local Git commit relative to repository baseline 07d9ada. The commit has not been pushed to GitHub. Live competitive strength, native movement, save/load and multiplayer still require playtesting.

Source, configuration, release notes, and original mod credits:
https://github.com/xunboo/CnC_Remastered_Collection
